info.name: Mastercard Bill Payment Validator Account Opening Dashboards API
Mastercard Used to Retrieve the Short-lived Url of a User's Dashboard to View Their Carbon Footprints and Contributions to Priceless Planet.

params.name: userid
params.description: Unique identifier for a user enrolled into Carbon Calculator Experience platform.

params.name: lang
params.description: Language preference (en-US - English, es-cr - Spanish (Costa Rica), es-cl - Spanish (Chile), sv - Swedish, pl-PL - Polish (Poland))

items.docs: It allows issuers to retrieve a short-lived URL for an enrolled user. An Issuer needs to load this URL within their application so that the user can view the dashboard in their preferred language. Currently, four languages are supported, including English, Spanish (Latin America), Swedish, and Polish.
